questions.stem: Three corners of a rectangle are $(3, 2)$, $(3, 8)$ and $(11, 2)$. What is the area of the rectangle, in square units?
questions.solution: One side runs from y = 2 to y = 8, so it is 6 units long. The other runs from x = 3 to x = 11, so it is 8 units long. The area is $6 \times 8 = 48$ square units.

questions.skill: Missing corner of a rectangle or square
questions.stem: A square has one corner at $(4, 4)$ and sides 5 units long that run to the right and up from that corner. Which point is the corner opposite $(4, 4)$?
questions.solution: Going 5 units right and 5 units up from $(4, 4)$ reaches $(9, 9)$. The points $(9, 4)$ and $(4, 9)$ are the two corners next to $(4, 4)$.

questions.skill: Coordinates in a map or story
questions.stem: Zoe walks along a straight street from the bakery at $(4, 6)$ to the library at $(10, 6)$. Then she walks straight to the park at $(10, 2)$. Each unit is 1 block. How many blocks does she walk in all?
questions.solution: The first part is along a horizontal line: $10 - 4 = 6$ blocks. The second part is along a vertical line: $6 - 2 = 4$ blocks. In all she walks $6 + 4 = 10$ blocks.

questions.skill: Coordinates in a map or story
questions.stem: On a grid map each unit is 1 mile. The cafe is at $(2, 5)$, the gym is at $(2, 12)$ and the pool is at $(8, 5)$. Which statement is true?
choices: The pool is 1 mile farther from the cafe than the gym is
The gym and the pool are the same distance from the cafe
The gym is 7 miles farther from the cafe than the pool is
The gym is 1 mile farther from the cafe than the pool is
questions.answer: The gym is 1 mile farther from the cafe than the pool is
questions.solution: The gym is straight up from the cafe: $12 - 5 = 7$ miles. The pool is straight across: $8 - 2 = 6$ miles. So the gym is $7 - 6 = 1$ mile farther away.

solve.answer: The gym is 1 mile farther from the cafe than the pool is
solve.work: Gym: 12 - 5 = 7 mi; pool: 8 - 2 = 6 mi. Gym is 1 mile farther.

questions.skill: Coordinates in a map or story
questions.stem: A treasure is hidden 8 units right of the y-axis and 5 units up from the x-axis. A second treasure is 3 units to the right of the first, at the same distance from the x-axis. What is the x-coordinate of the second treasure?
questions.solution: The first treasure is at $(8, 5)$. Moving 3 units to the right at the same height gives $(11, 5)$, so the x-coordinate is 11.

questions.skill: Order and nest the categories
questions.stem: Which of these groups includes all of the others?
questions.solution: Every square, every rectangle and every rhombus is a parallelogram. None of the other groups includes all the rest.

solve.work: Squares, rectangles and rhombuses are all parallelograms.

questions.skill: True and false statements about the hierarchy
questions.stem: Which statement is always true?
questions.solution: A square has 4 right angles and opposite sides that are equal, so it has every attribute of a rectangle. A rectangle can have sides of different lengths, so it is not always a square.

solve.work: A square has 4 right angles, so it is always a rectangle. Others fail.

questions.skill: Classify a shape from its attributes
questions.stem: A flat shape has 4 straight sides and 4 square corners. Which is the most specific name that is sure to fit it?
questions.solution: Four square corners make it a rectangle. It might have sides of different lengths, so it is not sure to be a square or a rhombus. "Parallelogram" is true too, but a rectangle is more specific.

solve.work: 4 right angles guarantees a rectangle; not necessarily a square or rhombus; rectangle more specific than parallelogram.

questions.skill: Attributes pass down to subcategories
questions.stem: Which attribute do ALL parallelograms have, so that every rectangle has it too?
choices: All four angles are right angles
Exactly one pair of parallel sides
questions.solution: Every parallelogram has opposite sides that are parallel, and a rectangle is a parallelogram. Equal sides and right angles are not true of all parallelograms.

solve.work: All parallelograms have opposite sides parallel, inherited by rectangles. Others are not true of all parallelograms.

questions.skill: Classify a shape from its attributes
questions.stem: A flat shape has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. Which is the most specific name for it?
questions.solution: 4 equal sides make it a rhombus and 4 square corners make it a rectangle. A shape that is both is a square, the most specific name.

solve.work: Four equal sides and four right angles: square (most specific).

questions.skill: Sort shapes into categories
questions.stem: Look at these shapes: a square, a rectangle, a rhombus, and a triangle. How many of them are parallelograms?
questions.solution: Squares, rectangles and rhombuses all have 2 pairs of parallel sides, so they are parallelograms. A triangle is not. That makes 3.

solve.work: Square, rectangle, rhombus are parallelograms; triangle is not. 3.

questions.skill: Attributes pass down to subcategories
questions.stem: Every parallelogram has 2 pairs of parallel sides. A rectangle is a parallelogram. How many pairs of parallel sides does every rectangle have?
questions.solution: A rectangle is a parallelogram, so it has every attribute of a parallelogram. It has 2 pairs of parallel sides.

solve.work: Rectangle is a parallelogram, so it inherits 2 pairs of parallel sides.

questions.skill: True and false statements about the hierarchy
questions.stem: Which statement is NOT always true?
questions.solution: A rectangle can have sides of different lengths, but a rhombus has 4 equal sides. The other three statements are always true.

solve.work: A rectangle need not have equal sides, so it is not always a rhombus; the others are always true.

questions.skill: Use a category's attribute on a subcategory
questions.stem: Every parallelogram has opposite sides that are equal in length. A rectangle is a parallelogram. One side of a rectangle is 7 cm long and the next side is 3 cm long. How long, in centimeters, is the side opposite the 7 cm side?
questions.solution: A rectangle is a parallelogram, so its opposite sides are equal. The side opposite the 7 cm side is also 7 cm.

solve.work: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal; the side opposite the 7 cm side is 7 cm.

questions.skill: Attributes pass down the hierarchy
questions.stem: All parallelograms have two pairs of parallel sides. A rhombus is a parallelogram. Which must be true of every rhombus?
choices: It has two pairs of parallel sides
It has exactly one pair of parallel sides
Its diagonals are the same length
questions.answer: It has two pairs of parallel sides
questions.solution: A rhombus is a kind of parallelogram, so it has every attribute of a parallelogram, including two pairs of parallel sides. Four right angles and equal diagonals belong to rectangles, not to every rhombus.

solve.answer: It has two pairs of parallel sides
solve.work: Rhombus is a parallelogram, so two pairs of parallel sides.

questions.skill: Use a category's attribute on a subcategory
questions.stem: A square is a rhombus, and every rhombus has 4 sides that are all the same length. A square has a perimeter of 36 cm. How long, in centimeters, is each side of the square?
questions.solution: All 4 sides of a square are equal. Each side is 36 divided by 4, which is 9 cm.

questions.skill: Classify a shape from its attributes
questions.stem: A quadrilateral has 4 equal sides, but its corners are not square corners. Which is the most specific name that fits?
questions.solution: Four equal sides make it a rhombus. Because its corners are not square corners, it is not a square or a rectangle. "Parallelogram" is true but less specific.

solve.work: 4 equal sides makes it a rhombus; no right angles so not a square (or rectangle). Most specific: rhombus.

questions.skill: Sort shapes into categories
questions.stem: A rectangle that is not a square has sides of 3 cm and 7 cm. Here are 5 names: quadrilateral, parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus, square. How many of the names fit this rectangle?
questions.solution: The shape is a rectangle, so it is also a parallelogram and a quadrilateral. Its sides are not all equal, so it is not a rhombus or a square. 3 names fit.

solve.work: A 3 by 7 rectangle is a quadrilateral, a parallelogram and a rectangle; not a rhombus (sides unequal) nor a square. 3 names.

questions.skill: Attributes pass down to subcategories
questions.stem: Which description does NOT fit every rectangle?
choices: a shape with 2 pairs of parallel sides
questions.solution: A rectangle always has 4 sides, 4 right angles and 2 pairs of parallel sides. Its sides are not always all equal. Only a rectangle that is a square has that.

solve.work: Every rectangle has 4 sides, 4 right angles, 2 pairs of parallel sides; not every rectangle has 4 equal sides.

questions.skill: Order and nest the categories
questions.stem: Quadrilateral: 4 straight sides. A parallelogram has everything a quadrilateral has and adds: opposite sides parallel. A rectangle has everything a parallelogram has and adds: 4 right angles. A square has everything a rectangle has and adds: 4 equal sides. How many attributes in this list does every square have?
questions.solution: A square keeps the quadrilateral attribute (4 straight sides), the parallelogram attribute (opposite sides parallel) and the rectangle attribute (4 right angles), and adds its own (4 equal sides). That is 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4.

solve.work: Square has: 4 straight sides, opposite sides parallel, 4 right angles, 4 equal sides: 4 attributes.

questions.skill: True and false statements about the hierarchy
questions.stem: Which statement about squares and rhombuses is true?
choices: Every rhombus is a square, but not every square is a rhombus
Every square is a rhombus, and every rhombus is a square
A square can never be a rhombus
Every square is a rhombus, but not every rhombus is a square
questions.answer: Every square is a rhombus, but not every rhombus is a square
questions.solution: A square has 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. A rhombus may not have square corners, so it is not always a square.

solve.answer: Every square is a rhombus, but not every rhombus is a square
solve.work: A square has 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus; a rhombus need not have right angles.

questions.skill: True and false statements about the hierarchy
questions.stem: Maya says, "A rectangle can never be a rhombus." Which fact shows she is wrong?
choices: A rectangle has four right angles but may have unequal sides
A rhombus has four equal sides but may have unequal angles
A square has four right angles and four equal sides
Every parallelogram has two pairs of parallel sides
questions.answer: A square has four right angles and four equal sides
questions.solution: A square has four right angles, so it is a rectangle. It also has four equal sides, so it is a rhombus. One shape that is both shows that a rectangle can be a rhombus.

solve.answer: A square has four right angles and four equal sides
solve.work: A square is a rectangle with four equal sides, so it is a rhombus too: a rectangle can be a rhombus.

questions.skill: Sort shapes into categories
questions.stem: Here are 4 shapes: a square, a rhombus, a parallelogram with 4 right angles, and a parallelogram. How many of them are always rectangles?
questions.solution: A square is a rectangle. A parallelogram with 4 right angles is a rectangle. A rhombus can have angles that are not right angles, and a parallelogram does not always have 4 right angles. So 2 of the shapes are always rectangles.

solve.work: Square: always a rectangle (4 right angles). Rhombus: not always. Parallelogram with 4 right angles: a rectangle. General parallelogram: not always. Count = 2.

questions.skill: Order and nest the categories
questions.stem: Which list goes from the broadest category to the most specific?
questions.solution: Every square is a rectangle, every rectangle is a parallelogram, and every parallelogram is a quadrilateral. So the broadest category comes first and the square last.

solve.work: Quadrilateral contains parallelogram contains rectangle contains square.

questions.skill: Attributes pass down to subcategories
questions.stem: All parallelograms have opposite sides that are equal in length. Which shapes must also have opposite sides equal in length?
questions.solution: Rectangles, rhombuses and squares are all parallelograms, so they all have this attribute. A quadrilateral that is not a parallelogram may not have it.

solve.work: Rectangles, rhombuses and squares are all parallelograms, so all have opposite sides equal.

questions.skill: True and false statements about the hierarchy
questions.stem: Which statement is true?
questions.solution: A square is a rhombus and also a rectangle, so some rhombuses are rectangles. A rhombus with angles that are not right angles is not a rectangle, and a rectangle with unequal sides is not a rhombus.

solve.work: A square is both a rhombus and a rectangle, so some rhombuses are rectangles.

questions.skill: Use a category's attribute on a subcategory
questions.stem: Every rectangle is a parallelogram, so its opposite sides are equal in length. A rectangle has one side of 8 cm and a perimeter of 34 cm. How long, in centimeters, is the side next to the 8 cm side?
questions.solution: Opposite sides are equal, so two sides of 8 cm are used. The sum of two neighboring sides is half of the perimeter: 34 / 2 = 17. The other side is 17 - 8 = 9 cm.

questions.skill: Order and nest the categories
questions.stem: What is the most specific category that includes all rectangles, all rhombuses, and all squares?
questions.solution: All three kinds have 2 pairs of parallel sides, so all are parallelograms. Quadrilaterals include them too, but that category is broader. Rectangles do not include every rhombus, and rhombuses do not include every rectangle.

solve.work: Rectangles, rhombuses and squares are all parallelograms; rhombuses are not all rectangles and vice versa. Most specific: parallelograms.

questions.skill: Classify a shape from its attributes
questions.stem: A quadrilateral has 2 pairs of parallel sides and 4 equal sides. Its angles measure 60, 120, 60 and 120 degrees. Here are 5 names: quadrilateral, parallelogram, rectangle, rhombus, square. How many of the names fit it?
questions.solution: It has 2 pairs of parallel sides, so it is a parallelogram and a quadrilateral. It has 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. It has no right angles, so it is not a rectangle or a square. 3 names fit.

solve.work: Rhombus with 60/120 angles: quadrilateral, parallelogram, rhombus fit; not rectangle or square. 3.

questions.skill: Attributes pass down to subcategories
questions.stem: Which argument is correct?
choices: Squares have 4 right angles and squares are rhombuses, so rhombuses have 4 right angles
Squares have 4 equal sides and squares are rectangles, so rectangles have 4 equal sides
Rectangles have 4 right angles and squares are rectangles, so squares have 4 right angles
Squares have 4 right angles and squares are parallelograms, so parallelograms have 4 right angles
questions.answer: Rectangles have 4 right angles and squares are rectangles, so squares have 4 right angles
questions.solution: Attributes of a category belong to every subcategory, so they pass down from rectangles to squares. They do not pass up: some rhombuses, rectangles and parallelograms are not squares.

solve.answer: Rectangles have 4 right angles and squares are rectangles, so squares have 4 right angles
solve.work: Attributes pass down from a category to subcategories: rectangles have 4 right angles, squares are rectangles, so squares have 4 right angles. Others pass attributes up, which is invalid.

questions.skill: Sort shapes into categories
questions.stem: Six quadrilaterals are described. A: 4 equal sides and 4 right angles. B: 4 right angles, with sides of 3 cm and 5 cm. C: 4 equal sides and no right angles. D: 2 pairs of parallel sides, neighboring sides unequal, no right angles. E: 2 pairs of parallel sides, 4 equal sides, no right angles. F: only 1 pair of parallel sides. How many of the six are rhombuses?
questions.solution: A rhombus is a quadrilateral with 4 equal sides. A, C and E have 4 equal sides. B, D and F do not. So 3 are rhombuses (A is a square, which is also a rhombus).

solve.work: Rhombus = 4 equal sides: A (square), C, E. B rectangle 3x5, D parallelogram, F trapezoid are not. 3.

questions.skill: Sort shapes into categories
questions.stem: A teacher has 10 shapes: 3 squares, 2 rectangles that are not squares, 2 rhombuses that are not squares, 2 parallelograms that are neither rectangles nor rhombuses, and 1 quadrilateral that is not a parallelogram. How many of the 10 shapes have 2 pairs of parallel sides?
questions.solution: Squares, rectangles, rhombuses and parallelograms all have 2 pairs of parallel sides: 3 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 9. Only the last quadrilateral, which is not a parallelogram, is left out.

solve.work: Parallelograms: squares 3, rectangles 2, rhombuses 2, parallelograms 2 = 9. The other quadrilateral is not.

questions.skill: Classify a shape from its attributes
questions.stem: A quadrilateral has 4 right angles and 4 equal sides. Which list contains only names that fit it?
questions.solution: It is a square, and a square is also a rectangle, a rhombus, a parallelogram and a quadrilateral. A pentagon, a triangle and a hexagon have the wrong number of sides.

solve.work: A square is a square, rectangle, rhombus, parallelogram, quadrilateral; not triangle, pentagon, hexagon.

questions.skill: Count the true statements
questions.stem: Count how many of these statements are true. Every square is a rectangle. Every rectangle is a square. Every rhombus is a parallelogram. Every parallelogram is a rhombus. Every square is a rhombus.
questions.solution: True: every square is a rectangle; every rhombus is a parallelogram; every square is a rhombus. False: not every rectangle is a square; not every parallelogram is a rhombus. So 3 are true.

solve.work: Square is rectangle: T. Rectangle is square: F. Rhombus is parallelogram: T. Parallelogram is rhombus: F. Square is rhombus: T. Count 3.

questions.skill: Spot an impossible description
questions.stem: Which description is impossible for any quadrilateral?
choices: a rhombus whose four angles are all right angles
a rectangle whose four sides are all equal
a rectangle with only one pair of parallel sides
a parallelogram with two different side lengths
questions.answer: a rectangle with only one pair of parallel sides
questions.solution: Every rectangle is a parallelogram, so it has two pairs of parallel sides. The other three are possible: a square, a square, and a rectangle that is not a square.

solve.answer: a rectangle with only one pair of parallel sides
solve.work: A rectangle is a parallelogram, so it has two pairs of parallel sides; "only one pair" is impossible. A square is a rhombus with right angles and a rectangle with equal sides; a non-rhombus parallelogram has two side lengths.
